status.noTenant: The namespace is not bound to a tenant

tenants.search: Search tenants by name, slug, owner…
tenants.limitsAboutBody: Values here replace the platform defaults for this tenant only. Reset to defaults to follow the platform again.
tenants.limitsReset: Limits of {{name}} reset to platform defaults
tenants.assignOwnerHint: {{name}} — current owner: {{owner}}. The previous owner becomes an admin; the new one must not own another tenant.
tenants.orphanedBody: The owner account was deleted. Assign a new owner to make the tenant active again.
tenants.suspendWarnBody: Launches are blocked, tokens stop working, schedules pause.
tenants.suspendReasonHint: Shown to the owner and in the audit log.
tenants.deleteBody: All runs, results, library objects, providers, tokens and webhooks are removed; the Graphene namespace is retired. This cannot be undone.
tenants.deleteBlocked: Live runs are in progress — the server will refuse until they finish or are cancelled.

users.search: Search users by name or e-mail…
users.fromConfig: Granted by the server config (STROPPY_ADMIN_EMAILS); cannot be changed here.
users.self: You cannot change your own admin flag.
users.revoked: {{name}} is no longer a platform admin

runs.hint: Global queue across all tenants. Without a status filter only live runs (pending, running, cancelling) are listed.
runs.cancelBody: The run in tenant {{tenant}} stops and its stand is torn down. The author is notified; the action is recorded in the audit log.
runs.notLive: The run is not live — nothing to cancel
runs.tenantUnknown: The run's tenant was not found

settings.tenantCreationHint: Who may create a tenant. Every account still owns at most one.
settings.publicRatingHint: Enables the global rating page and the public_name setting for tenants.
settings.examplesHint: Shows the built-in example tests that can be cloned or quick-run.
settings.retentionMaxHint: No tenant limit may exceed this.
settings.defaultLimitsHint: Applied to every tenant without an admin override. Changing them updates those tenants immediately.
settings.catalogHint: Static source of /catalog/stroppy: available stroppy versions, images and scripts. Validated against the system.stroppy_catalog schema when present.
